basic_details.job_title: NIMS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Research Scientist II, Project Technical Support II/ III Posts
basic_details.short_information: Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences (NIMS) has announced 3 temporary vacancies for Research Scientist-II (Scientist C), Project Technical Support-II, and Project Technical Support-III posts. The tenure of these temporary positions is initially for one year and extendable based on the requirement, with pay ranging from Rs. 20,000 + 30% HRA to Rs. 67,000 + 30% HRA depending on the post. Qualification requirements vary according to the post, as specified in the official notification. how_to_apply: Download or obtain the prescribed application format (Form-A and Form-B) from the official notification PDF.
Fill out the application completely on a plain paper in the specified format.
Attach attested copies of all relevant certificates and supporting documents in support of educational qualifications, experience, and personal details.
Submit the filled application either by hand or through post to the Dean, Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences, Panjagutta, Hyderabad 5000082.
Ensure the application reaches the designated office on or before 27 October 2026 by 4:00 P.M. Applications can also be communicated via email to [email protected] as per contact details.

content_sections.heading: NIMS Research Scientist-II (Scientist C) at a Glance

rows.details: Precision Radiation in Rectal Cancer: A Randomized Controlled Trial of Genomic Profile-Guided versus Standard Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer
Research Scientist-II (Scientist C), Project Technical Support-II, Project Technical Support-III

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across three different posts for the ICMR Extramural Grant project.

rows.essential_qualification_required: M.Sc. (First Class) with a Ph.D. degree in relevant Life Science subjects such as Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Microbiology, Biotechnology, or related disciplines from a recognized university, plus minimum one year of post-doctoral research experience in the relevant field.
rows.desirable_qualification: Demonstrable experience in molecular biology techniques (PCR, qPCR, NGS, Sanger sequencing, Western blot analysis, ELISA, flow cytometry); publications in indexed peer-reviewed journals; knowledge of biostatistics and bioinformatics tools for NEGs data processing; experience in scientific writing.

rows.essential_qualification_required: BSc in life science or BSc MLT with two year experience in a clinical laboratory.
rows.desirable_qualification: Hands-on experience in laboratory and project-related technical activities; basic laboratory/diagnostic procedures; adherence to SOPs and quality-control procedures; data entry and management using MS Office/Excel; experience in a hospital, medical college, research institute, or diagnostic laboratory.

rows.essential_qualification_required: Three Years Graduate degree in Life Sciences + three years post qualification experience OR Post Graduate degree in Life Sciences.
rows.desirable_qualification: Experience in research/project-based technical activities mainly in clinical trial; experience in basic molecular biology techniques including nucleic acid extraction and processing for NGS sequencing and analysis; preparation of technical/project reports; experience in clinical research, laboratory-based research, public-health projects; proficiency in large clinical data management.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions are temporary and created under an ICMR Extramural Grant project. The tenure is initially for one year and is extendable based on project requirements. The monthly salary varies by post: Rs. 67,000 plus 30% HRA for Research Scientist-II (Scientist C), Rs. 28,000 plus 30% HRA for Project Technical Support-III, and Rs. 20,000 plus 30% HRA for Project Technical Support-II.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIMS Research Scientist-II (Scientist C)
content_sections.text: Download or obtain the prescribed application format (Form-A and Form-B) from the official notification PDF. Fill out the application completely on a plain paper in the specified format. Attach attested copies of all relevant certificates and supporting documents in support of educational qualifications, experience, and personal details. Submit the filled application either by hand or through post to the Dean, Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences, Panjagutta, Hyderabad 5000082. Ensure the application reaches the designated office on or before 27 October 2026 by 4:00 P.M. Applications can also be communicated via email to [email protected] as per contact details.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received within the stipulated deadline will be reviewed, and eligible candidates will be intimated regarding the date, time, and place of the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is this NIMS recruitment for a permanent or temporary position?
faq.answer: The positions are temporary and established for an ICMR Extramural Grant project, with an initial tenure of one year that is extendable based on project requirements.

faq.question: Q2. Are HRA and other allowances paid in addition to the consolidated salary?
faq.answer: Yes, the salary for all three posts includes the specified consolidated amount plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What are the desirable qualifications for the Research Scientist-II post?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include demonstrable experience in molecular biology techniques such as PCR, qPCR, NGS, Sanger sequencing, Western blot analysis, ELISA, and flow cytometry, along with publications in indexed peer-reviewed journals and knowledge of biostatistics and bioinformatics tools.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the selection process?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates who submit their applications on or before 27 October 2026 by 4:00 P.M. will be shortlisted, and the date, time, and place of the interview will be intimated directly to them.
